purpose: Exportable, non-automated documentary request checklists for 35 exact CTR source decisions, with confirmed role-based requirements, no actual vendors assigned.

control_principles.explanation: FSSAI publishes analytical methods separately from laboratory recognition; method presence is not a given lab's current accredited method/matrix scope.
FSSAI recognizes NABL-accredited primary and referral food laboratories for statutory tasks. A commercial/private QA test arrangement must not be labeled a statutory sample-analysis appointment.
Ask lab for current valid accreditation and individual test/analyte, method, matrix and LOQ; listing alone does not document actual analyte capability.
Keep December 2026 contaminant amendment and April 2027 laboratory analysis commencement future-effective, not current 16 October 2026 compliance.
CSV evidence requests are templates only; nobody or any lot is marked cleared, compliant or tested because a row was exported.
